grades.quote: The FENCE.I only synchronizes the local hart, and the OS can reschedule the user hart to a different physical hart after the FENCE.I.
grades.reason: Directly answers the query. FENCE.I synchronizes only the local hart, not all harts. After a migration the OS must execute an additional FENCE.I, which is why the Linux ABI requires a system call.
Describes the memory-ordering FENCE and FENCE.TSO for device I/O and memory accesses. It does not discuss FENCE.I or instruction-fetch synchronization across harts.
